subject: Contoso Azure co-sell referral — seller liaison & account swimlanes
messages:
From: Sara Malik <sara.malik@contoso.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Contoso referral: exploring Azure co-sell path

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Contoso is starting to formalize the co-sell plan for our joint platform migration opportunity and Microsoft asked us to route referrals through Partner Center so the field sellers can align. I attached a small export of our priority accounts and the partner contact list for initial mapping (filename: partnercenter-referral-export.csv) — the IDs are in column A.

High level ask: can Redwood help by mapping those referral rows to your field seller roster and propose a simple swimlane that we can present to the Azure PMs? We want to avoid duplicate outreach from both sides and make sure there's a clear path for canary co-sell motions on the top 12 accounts.

If useful, Timothy Ng (cc'd) from Azure can share the Partner Center referral IDs and the marketplace listing intake checklist.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Sara Malik
Director, GTM Partnerships
Contoso
attachments: partnercenter-referral-export.csv

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Malik <sara.malik@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-25T13:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contoso referral: exploring Azure co-sell path

Sara — appreciate the export. Looping in Vanessa (partner ops) and Karthik (field engagement) to own mapping and seller alignment.

Quick plan from my side:
- Vanessa/Karthik: take the partnercenter export and produce a row-level mapping to our seller roster; highlight accounts with conflicting owners.
- We'll surface a swimlane proposal (owner, backup owner, recommended outreach cadence) for the top 12 accounts and a fallback for lower-tier accounts.
- Schedule a 30-min alignment with Contoso + Azure PM to confirm the Partner Center referral attribution.

Can you confirm: which 12 accounts are highest priority for Contoso? If you prefer, mark a priority column in the CSV and re-upload — that'll speed things up.

Also tagging Laura from partnerships so we can align marketplace listing dependencies (co-sell readiness checklist items that Azure will expect).

Thanks — I'll wait on the updated CSV or a quick confirm and Vanessa will draft the swimlane.

— Marcus Lin
Head of Field GTM, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Sara Malik <sara.malik@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-26T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contoso referral: exploring Azure co-sell path

Thanks, Marcus & Sara — I pulled the export and started an initial draft mapping. See attached: contoso_account_map.xlsx. Highlights & questions: 

- I normalized Contoso's account names against our CRM and matched Partner Center referral IDs where present.
- 4 accounts have ambiguous owner tags in our CRM (listed in the "conflicts" tab). Those need field-owner confirmation (marked with ***).
- Proposed swimlane approach (draft):
  * Tier 1 (top 12): single field seller owner + Redwood seller liaison for enablement and collateral. Weekly sync for first month.
  * Tier 2 (next 30): regional seller pool; outbound sequencing via shared playbook.
  * Tier 3: inbound-only routing into self-serve funnel with marketplace trial offers.

Action items for Contoso: please confirm the Tier 1 list and, for any account marked ***, confirm your preferred Contoso point-of-contact so we can reconcile ownership.

I'll hold on the final swimlane until we confirm owners — I can then export a PDF and share the swimlane visually. Suggested 30-min cadence: Tue 11/30 10:00am PT — does that work for you and Timothy?

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: contoso_account_map.xlsx

From: Sara Malik <sara.malik@contoso.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Timothy Ng <timothy.ng@microsoft.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-27T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contoso referral: exploring Azure co-sell path

Vanessa — thanks for the draft. I updated the CSV with Contoso's priority flag and clarified the three contacts flagged as ambiguous (rows 7, 9, 12). Re-attaching our export for reference (partnercenter-referral-export.csv).

Two clarifications from our side: 
- Partner Center will only honor referral attribution if the referral is accepted within 30 days of submission — the IDs in column A are the current referral tokens.
- For account "Northwind Traders" we prefer Microsoft Field Seller "Hannah S." to own the outreach; Contoso will support with the local account team.

Timothy — can you confirm Microsoft will accept the swimlane approach and that there are no additional compliance steps for co-sell on these SKUs?

Best,
Sara

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Malik <sara.malik@contoso.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contoso referral: exploring Azure co-sell path — proposed swimlane

Sara / Vanessa — based on the reconciled list I put together a proposed swimlane (attached PDF: swimlane_draft.pdf) with seller assignments and backup owners. Short summary: 

- Tier 1 (12 accounts): mapped to dedicated field sellers in the West & Central regions; Redwood liaison is assigned to each account for enablement.
- Conflicts: 3 accounts await Microsoft seller confirmation (we flagged Hannah S. for Northwind Traders per your note).
- Outreach cadence: Initial joint email (Redwood + Contoso + Microsoft PM in cc), follow-up at day 5 by field seller, weekly sync for 4 weeks.

Proposed meeting: Tue 11/30 10:00am PT — 30 minutes to confirm sellers and agree on the joint email template. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a draft template ahead of the call.

Action items (Karthik): finalize swimlane PDF, create draft joint email template (for review), confirm Microsoft seller owners flagged as conflicts.

— Karthik
Director, Field Engagement
Redwood Inference
attachments: swimlane_draft.pdf

From: Sara Malik <sara.malik@contoso.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Timothy Ng <timothy.ng@microsoft.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T16:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contoso referral: exploring Azure co-sell path — proposed swimlane

Team — thanks, this looks good. 11/30 10:00am PT works for Contoso and Timothy is available to confirm Microsoft-side owners. We've accepted the swimlane draft and I've flagged the Tier 1 list in HubSpot (link below) so our sales ops can trace the outreach.

Next steps we agreed on: 
- Karthik to publish final swimlane and joint email template by EOD 11/30.
- Vanessa to attach the final PDF and send to the Microsoft PM for formal Partner Center acceptance.
- Contoso to monitor referral token acceptance window and notify Redwood if any token expires before acceptance.

Calendar invite & Teams link: https://teams.microsoft.com/l/meetup-join/19%3ameeting_example_link
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/12478

Looking forward — Sara

Contoso
